tools.name: phppos_list_locations
tools.description: List the store's locations (shops/warehouses) with name, address, phone, email, time zone and default tax rates, plus each location's registers (id and name). Use the location ids to filter sales, expenses, customers and reports. Payment-processor credentials and device settings are never returned.

tools.name: phppos_list_items
tools.description: List or search inventory items with name, item number, category, supplier, prices and reorder level. Search by text, or by one field (name, item_number, product_id, supplier, tag_name...). GET /items.

tools.name: phppos_get_item
tools.description: One inventory item by id: prices, tax settings, category, supplier, tags, attributes, variations, tier pricing and per-location settings. GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: phppos_list_categories
tools.description: List item categories with their ids. Use the ids to filter items or to file a new item. GET /categories.

tools.name: phppos_list_item_kits
tools.description: List item kits (bundles of items sold together) with their prices. GET /item_kits.

tools.name: phppos_list_sales
tools.description: List or search completed sales, by date range, customer (id or email) or location. verbosity: minimal (headline fields), medium (adds customer, totals, profit, location - the default here) or full (every line item, payment and tax). Suspended sales (layaways, estimates) are fetched with suspended_ty

tools.name: phppos_get_sale
tools.description: One sale by id with line items, payments, taxes, customer and employee (verbosity full by default). GET /sales/{id}.

tools.name: phppos_list_receivings
tools.description: List receivings (stock received from suppliers, purchase orders, transfers) with supplier, totals and items, by date range. GET /receivings.

tools.name: phppos_get_receiving
tools.description: One receiving by id: supplier, items, quantities, costs and payments. GET /receivings/{id}.

tools.name: phppos_list_customers
tools.description: List or search customers with contact details, tier, store-account balance, credit limit and loyalty points. Search by text or by one field (email, phone_number, first_name, last_name, account_number). GET /customers.

tools.name: phppos_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by person id: contact details, tier, tax settings, balance, credit limit, points, notes and custom fields. GET /customers/{person_id}.

tools.name: phppos_list_suppliers
tools.description: List or search suppliers with contact details, company, account number and balance. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: phppos_get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier by person id. GET /suppliers/{person_id}.

tools.name: phppos_list_employees
tools.description: List employees with name, contact details, username, hire date, manager, commission and pay rate settings and assigned locations. Passwords and the permission maps are never returned. GET /employees.

tools.name: phppos_list_invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices (money customers owe) or supplier invoices (money the store owes) with date, due date, status and amount. GET /invoices/customer or /invoices/supplier.

tools.name: phppos_list_expenses
tools.description: List recorded expenses with type, description, date, amount, tax, payment type, category and location. GET /expenses.

tools.name: phppos_list_gift_cards
tools.description: List gift cards with number, description, remaining value, customer and whether inactive. GET /giftcards.

tools.name: phppos_get_gift_card
tools.description: One gift card by its card number (or id): remaining value, customer and status. GET /giftcards/{giftcard_number}.

tools.name: phppos_list_appointments
tools.description: List appointments (bookings) with customer, employee, service, start and end time, optionally within a time window. GET /appointments.

tools.name: phppos_list_reports
tools.description: The catalog of the store's reports (138 of them: sales summaries, top sellers, inventory low/aging/summary, profit and loss, taxes, payments, employee, customer, supplier and store-account reports) with the inputs each accepts. Without `search` only the report keys are returned; with `search` (for e

tools.name: phppos_run_report
tools.description: Run one of the store's reports and return it (title, summary, detail rows); `paging.next_offset` is set when more detail rows remain. Report keys and their inputs come from phppos_list_reports (for example summary_sales, top_sellers, inventory_low, summary_profit_and_loss, summary_taxes, closeout).

tools.name: phppos_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in the store. Store-account balance, credit limit and loyalty points cannot be set here. Needs a Read/Write API key. Retrying creates a duplicate (check phppos_list_customers first). The store's 'new customer' webhook, if configured, fires. POST /customers.

tools.name: phppos_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing customer; only the fields you pass are sent. Overwrites the current values. Needs a Read/Write API key. The store's 'edit customer' webhook, if configured, fires. POST /customers/{person_id}.

tools.name: phppos_create_item
tools.description: WRITE: create an inventory item (name required). Stock quantities are not set here. Needs a Read/Write API key. Retrying creates a duplicate (search with phppos_list_items first). The store's item webhooks, if configured, fire. POST /items.

tools.name: phppos_update_item
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing item (for example its price, category or active state); only the fields you pass are sent. Overwrites the current values, and a price change applies to the next sale. Needs a Read/Write API key. The store's 'edit item' webhook, if configured, fires. POST /items/{i

tools.name: phppos_create_expense
tools.description: WRITE: record an expense in the store's books (description, amount and date). It affects expense and profit-and-loss reports. Needs a Read/Write API key. Retrying records it twice (check phppos_list_expenses first). POST /expenses.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: phppos_list_locations, phppos_list_sales, phppos_list_customers, phppos_create_customer, phppos_update_customer, phppos_create_item, phppos_update_item, phppos_create_expense · Private data: phppos_list_locations, phppos_list_categories, phppos_list_customers, phppos_get_customer, phppos_list_suppliers, phppos_list_employees, phppos_create_customer, phppos_update_customer, phppos_create_item, phppos_update_item, phppos_create_expense · Public sink: phppos_list_locations, phppos_list_sales, phppos_list_customers, phppos_create_customer, phppos_update_customer, phppos_create_item, phppos_update_item, phppos_create_expense · Destructive: phppos_run_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: phppos_list_locations, phppos_list_sales, phppos_list_customers, phppos_create_customer, phppos_update_customer, phppos_create_item, phppos_update_item, phppos_create_expense · Private data: phppos_list_locations, phppos_list_categories, phppos_list_customers, phppos_get_customer, phppos_list_suppliers, phppos_list_employees, phppos_create_customer, phppos_update_customer, phppos_create_item, phppos_update_item, phppos_create_expense · Public sink: phppos_list_locations, phppos_list_sales, phppos_list_customers, phppos_create_customer, phppos_update_customer, phppos_create_item, phppos_update_item, phppos_create_expense · Destructive: phppos_run_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
